name: Disneyland & DCA Classic Warm Cinnamon-Sugar Churro (Share Half in Remission)
whyItWorks: Classic Disneyland churros are made from refined wheat flour with zero nuts or seeds; sharing half of a plain cinnamon-sugar churro lets you enjoy the iconic treat without overloading on sugar or seasonal spicy/citrus glazes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stick to the Classic Cinnamon-Sugar Churro and share half—avoid seasonal churros rolled in spicy Flamin' Hot dust, sour citrus sugar, or heavy cream-cheese/berry-seed dips.
watchOuts: Fried pastry dough + sugar—share a portion after a protein meal rather than on an empty stomach
